QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_10

question.text: Per current NSE/SEBI material and the NISM VII workbook footnote, the STT rate on the sale of equity futures effective from April 1, 2026 is:

answer.text: 0.02% payable by the seller (applicable up to March 31, 2026)

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 117 of the current NISM VII workbook lists the seller-side STT on sale of equity futures as 0.020% up to the workbook table date, with a footnote that the rate is subject to change from April 1, 2026. Current NSE material confirms the equity futures STT rate becomes 0.05% from April 1, 2026. The Trap: 0.02% reflects the rate applicable up to March 31, 2026 — date-qualify the answer if necessary. 0.125% is the option-exercise rate on intrinsic value; 0.025% is the non-delivery equity STT rate paid by the seller, not the buyer. Cross-Exam Context: NISM VII and VIII both test the April-1-2026 STT changes on equity futures and option exercise.
